$comment: Site settings that change by academic year. calendar = the academic-year calendar file (district no-school days, semester dates, block schedule). Reusable teaching materials (pacing, lessons, journals, achievements) do not depend on the year. For a new year: add data/calendar-YYYY-YY.json, check it in the Lesson Manager, then change this path. Student progress is never touched. site = the public addresses printed on teacher exports (substitute plans, Quick Teach); exports never print a localhost address.
